recognize_zh: 上方中央有一顆巨大的原紅血球母細胞（giant pronormoblast），細胞質深藍色並有突起（cytoplasmic blebs），核內可見大而暗的類核仁包涵體，是微小病毒 B19（parvovirus B19）感染的典型線索。
features: Giant pronormoblasts, several times the size of surrounding cells
Intensely basophilic cytoplasm with irregular cytoplasmic blebs/pseudopods
Large round nucleus with finely dispersed chromatin and large dark nucleolus-like intranuclear inclusions
Paucity of maturing erythroid precursors in the background
Background of maturing granulocytic cells, lymphocytes and red cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered giant pronormoblasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm bearing blunt cytoplasmic blebs. Their large nuclei contain finely dispersed chromatin with prominent, dark, nucleolus-like intranuclear inclusions. Maturing erythroid precursors are sparse, while granulocytic precursors and lymphocytes are present in the background. Findings are consistent with parvovirus B19 infection with giant pronormoblasts, as seen in pure red cell aplasia or transient aplastic crisis.

ddx.dx: Acute erythroid leukemia / pure erythroid leukemia
ddx.vs: Leukemic proerythroblasts form sheets with vacuolated cytoplasm and lack viral intranuclear inclusions; parvovirus giant pronormoblasts are scattered in an erythroid-depleted marrow and are B19 immunostain/PCR positive.
Megaloblastic marrow is erythroid hyperplastic with a full spectrum of enlarged maturing precursors and giant metamyelocytes, not isolated giant pronormoblasts in an erythroid-hypoplastic background.

ddx.dx: Acute megakaryoblastic leukemia or metastatic tumor cells
ddx.vs: Megakaryoblasts show platelet-like cytoplasmic budding without intranuclear inclusions and express CD41/CD61, whereas parvovirus-infected cells are erythroid (CD71/E-cadherin positive) with glassy nuclear inclusions.
